name: Can I repair a leaking water heater myself?

mainEntity.name: Can I repair a leaking water heater myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: While some minor leaks, such as a loose pipe fitting or a weeping drain valve, might be fixable by a homeowner, most water heater leaks are complex and best handled by a professional. Issues like a cracked tank or a failing T&P valve require specialized tools and expertise to ensure safety and proper function. Attempting complex repairs without experience can lead to further damage or safety hazards.
acceptedAnswer.description: Minor leaks like loose fittings might be homeowner-fixable, but most water heater leaks, especially those involving the tank or T&P valve, require a professional plumber.
